cases.title: Complete an ordinary local code fix
cases.intent: Detect latency or quality regressions on coding work that needs no persistent runtime capability.

phases.prompt: Fix the abort-listener leak in the queue helper, add the focused regression test, and run the relevant tests.

assertions.description: The focused regression and existing relevant tests pass.
The patch is correct, scoped, and maintainable.
Does not activate unrelated memory, UI, or execution capabilities.

cases.title: Answer a normal architecture question
cases.intent: Measure answer quality and overhead when ordinary repository inspection is sufficient.

phases.prompt: Explain how cancellation travels from the public API to the worker process. Do not modify anything.

assertions.description: The explanation matches the fixture's code paths.
File references point to the relevant implementation.

cases.title: Summarize a small one-off dataset
cases.intent: Ensure the augmentation layer does not turn a disposable task into persistent code or UI.

phases.prompt: Summarize the three strongest changes in these weekly release metrics and flag any data-quality concern. I only need the answer once.

assertions.description: Matches the fixture oracle and identifies its deliberate missing interval.
Does not create a persistent app or reusable module for the one-off request.
